minor.issue: brand = min(brands, key=...) raises ValueError on an empty sequence when a tenant has neither brand_names nor name (brands == []). Guard with `if not brands: return [], {...status 'degraded'...}` or fall back to the primary domain label.

A non-quota exception inside the top-up loop only records `error` and keeps looping over the remaining 10 platforms; each retry can burn the 60s httpx timeout (up to ~10 min against the 220s deadline it only checks before the call). Break (or count) on repeated generic failures too.

The 9 surviving social findings were created BEFORE the fix: their evidence.query is the tagline dork ('Globally recognized leaders in Home Textiles and Line Pipes (site:... OR ...)') and evidence.matched_brand is the tagline. Once quota resets, consider re-running and/or backfilling those 9 so the drawer Evidence tab doesn't show a garbage query.

_RUNNING_SCANS is process-local; the overlap guard silently breaks with >1 uvicorn worker. Move the in-flight lock to Mongo or document the single-worker requirement.
The combined dork still includes pastebin.com (a Data Exposure host) among the social sites, so 'Pastebin' appears in the Social Media platform dropdown. Split social vs data-exposure dorks.

The quota message is derived by string-sniffing the error ('request rejected' / 'limit' in error). Prefer a typed flag (e.g. quota_hit -> a dedicated message constant) so unrelated errors containing the word 'limit' aren't mislabelled as a quota problem.

(2) the search query was built from brand_names[0], which for this tenant is a marketing tagline; the new domain-label match (welspun.com -> 'Welspun') plus fewest-word fallback now selects the real brand, and gl is derived from the tenant country (India -> 'in'). Verified by capturing the query built inside collect_search_dork. Live volume verification remains impossible until the user's scrape.do quota resets or is upgraded.
